title: seed loader: a declared seed row a person deleted comes back under a new id at the next seed replay — record landed keys per organization and skip the ones now absent
body:
repo:cloud#3 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjRhUZjdy8VXs6Kkur2

Filing gate: **(b) a defect with a named consumer**, measured by the objectstack-ai/cloud#3657 dev (report on that card; PR objectstack-ai/cloud#3685). Platform defects go to the platform: 「平台的问题应该在平台处理」 (objectstack#30765).

## 维护者速读

用户删掉的示例数据，下次装包或升级、种子数据有变化时，平台会按新 id 重新插回来。cloud 实测 3 次，结果都一样。自托管的 `objectstack serve` 每次启动都会重跑种子，按代码看也是同样的问题。需要平台记住每个组织哪些种子行已经落过地，之后被删掉的就不再插回。

## Measured (cloud tenant-kernel rig: real `ArtifactKernelFactory` on SQLite with the framework seed-replayer; pin `c50e0dfa`; 3 runs, default and upsert modes)

- **Per-row delete, then an upgrade that changes the seed union:** the deleted row returns under a NEW id. Run 1: Globex `k6Gf2KcO40siHUPg` came back as `YkNS7s5N5l9jFMbn`.
- **The sanctioned cleanup with one edited row kept:** `deleted=4`, then the upgrade put all 4 back.
- **A full cleanup while `data[]` is still served** (an environment's own app): everything returned.
- **Re-inserting code:** the framework `SeedLoaderService` inserts any declared row it does not find (create-only rule, #30081). `runtime/src/app-plugin.ts` builds the `SeedLoaderRequestSchema` with no exclusion; `SeedLoaderConfigSchema` has no skip or tombstone option. `objectstack serve` re-runs its inline seed create-only on every boot (read, not measured).

## Expected (shape A, chosen under the standing rule)

- The framework keeps a durable per-organization record of which seed rows landed (object + `externalId` value). The seed loader skips a key recorded as landed that is now absent. One fix covers `objectstack serve` and hosted; cloud adds nothing, or only passes the organization.
- A deliberate re-seed (a reset or "restore sample data" action) can clear the record. The lane names the door.

## Acceptance

- Tests: delete a seeded row → a union change or reboot does not bring it back; an edited row is untouched; a new seed row added by an upgrade still lands; a reset re-seeds.

Consumer: objectstack-ai/cloud#3657 item 2, which stays open on this card.

Suggested-grade: p1.

Dedupe (2026-11-06): `seed loader tombstone` → 53 hits, `seed replay deleted row` → 188, `create-only seed deleted` → 225; the top hits are QA runs and closed lint cards. None covers this.
